parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null. Without any field-level or method-level evidence to ground a recommendation, it is impossible to determine whether `MP3Streamer` genuinely implements a subset of `TimeShiftablePlayer`'s interface or whether the pairing is an artefact of an incomplete pipeline run. Recommending a refactor without grounded evidence would risk introducing incorrect protocol conformances or unnecessary abstractions. Per the decision rules, when evidence cannot be cited from the cluster row, 'no-action' with reason_class 'coincidental' is the correct outcome.
